import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
a = df[df.account_id=='49tAGZz']
base = a[a.date=='2025-10-12'].set_index(['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family'])
anom = a[a.date=='2025-10-13'].set_index(['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family'])
j = base.join(anom, lsuffix='_b', rsuffix='_a', how='outer')
cols=[c for c in j.columns]
print(cols)
d = (j['unblended_cost_a'] - j['unblended_cost_b']).fillna(j['unblended_cost_a'])
print(d[d.abs()>0.001])
# also rows only in one
print("only base:", set(base.index)-set(anom.index))
print("only anom:", set(anom.index)-set(base.index))
